en.title: KOL vault
en.description: 100% of the trading tax lands here. At each market-cap milestone the vault buys the payout token and books an equal share for every KOL on the list. KOLs claim when they want.

en.notices.afterLast: All milestones are paid. New tax keeps paying the KOLs while the market cap stays above the last milestone.
